title: Cloud Intelligence — YTIntel Keeps Learning Between Visits
summary: YTIntel is no longer limited to one browser session. v0.26 adds optional creator accounts, secure multi-device workspace sync, server-side scheduled monitoring, persistent opportunity alerts, cloud longitudinal history and own-channel fit evidence while preserving the existing evidence guardrails.
discord_changes: Added optional creator accounts + secure cloud workspace sync so research, ideas and longitudinal intelligence can follow the creator across devices.
Added real server-side scheduled monitoring for saved competitors, niche evidence and the creator’s own channel, with persistent breakout/acceleration alerts.
Added own-channel fit evidence so Make This Next can show whether a market opportunity overlaps with repeated patterns from the creator’s stronger channel-relative uploads.
changes: Added Supabase Auth-based creator accounts without forcing sign-in for local trial use.
Added per-user Row Level Security for creator profiles, competitor watchlists, workspace state, cloud snapshots, alerts and product feedback.
Added multi-device cloud workspace sync for Creator Workspace, competitors, Idea Vault, Radar history, package history, Creator Loop experiments, Watchtower history and longitudinal timelines.
Added a server-side monitoring worker that reuses YTIntel’s current discovery engine and stores timestamped channel-relative observations in the cloud.

Added a pg_cron scheduler that wakes every 15 minutes and processes creator workspaces when their selected monitoring interval is due; the default interval is six hours and can be changed to 3, 6, 12 or 24 hours.
Added persistent cloud alerts for new uploads, newly verified >=1.5x breakouts, >=3x strong breakouts and observed channel-relative acceleration. Alerts are threshold evidence, not forecasts.
Added background niche monitoring with channel-baseline verification for a limited set of candidate channels rather than inventing niche-wide outlier multiples from raw views.
Added own-channel longitudinal snapshots and a personal evidence model built from repeated >=1.5x channel-relative winners.
Added personal fit evidence to the production decision. It waits for at least five own-channel observations and multiple winners before displaying stronger overlap language.
Added cloud-to-local hydration so server snapshots compound the existing v0.25 longitudinal timeline on the creator’s device.
Added a lightweight usefulness feedback control so real creator feedback can be collected against the current workspace state.
Added an in-app v0.26 release card and updated the PWA cache/installed-app metadata.

Preserved Always-On analysis, verified-vs-unverified language, channel-relative baselines, winner/control checks, originality guardrails and the rule that public evidence does not prove future views, CTR, private retention or causation.
why_it_matters: This closes one of the largest gaps between an impressive research tool and a product creators can rely on repeatedly: YTIntel can now remember the workspace across devices, keep collecting real observations between visits and make the next session more personal because it has retained both market history and the creator’s own channel evidence.
